bg-15-01.hint: If it rains, I stay home.
bg-15-01.why: 오다 has no batchim, so it attaches -면 directly: 비가 오면.

bg-15-01.q: Write one sentence saying what happens if you read a lot of books, using 읽으면 and 좋아져요.
bg-15-01.why: 읽다 has a batchim, so it attaches -으면: 읽으면.

steps.en: If it rains, I stay at home.
If it rains on the weekend, I stay at home.

ko: 하지만 비가 오면 밖으로 나가지 않아요.
집에 있으면 따뜻한 차를 마시고 영화를 봐요.
en: If the weather is nice, I exercise at the park.
However, if it rains, I do not go outside.
When I stay home, I drink warm tea and watch movies.

bg-15-01.q: What does the speaker do when the weather is nice?
bg-15-01.why: The passage says '날씨가 좋으면 공원에서 운동해요' (If the weather is nice, I exercise at the park).

bg-15-01.q: What does the speaker do when staying at home on a rainy day?
options: Drinks warm tea and watches movies
Invites friends over for a party
bg-15-01.why: The passage says '집에 있으면 따뜻한 차를 마시고 영화를 봐요' (When at home, I drink warm tea and watch movies).

items: I can express 'if' or 'when' conditions using -(으)면
I can attach -면 directly to ㄹ-stem verbs like 살다 and 만들다 without adding 으

bg-15-02.why: 마시다 has no batchim, so it attaches -면서: 마시면서.

bg-15-02.q: Write one sentence saying you greet someone while smiling, using 웃으면서 and 인사해요.
bg-15-02.why: 웃다 has a batchim, so it takes -으면서 to show two actions done at the same time.

bg-15-02.hint: 듣다 is a ㄷ irregular verb: ㄷ changes to ㄹ before -(으)면서.
bg-15-02.why: Before vowel ending -으면서, 듣다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ: 들으면서.

steps.en: I walk in the park while listening to music.
I walk in the park while listening to quiet music.

ko: 이어폰으로 좋아하는 노래를 들으면서 천천히 걸어요.
가끔 벤치에 앉아서 밤하늘을 보면서 쉬어요.
en: Minsu takes a walk in the park every evening.
He walks slowly while listening to his favorite songs through earphones.
Sometimes he sits on a bench and rests while looking at the night sky.

bg-15-02.q: What does Minsu do while walking in the park?
options: He listens to his favorite songs
bg-15-02.why: The passage says '좋아하는 노래를 들으면서 천천히 걸어요' (He walks slowly while listening to his favorite songs).

bg-15-02.q: What does Minsu look at while resting on a bench?
bg-15-02.why: The passage states '벤치에 앉아서 밤하늘을 보면서 쉬어요' (He sits on a bench and rests while looking at the night sky).

items: I can describe two actions done at the same time using -(으)면서
I can apply ㄷ irregular and ㄹ-stem rules accurately before -(으)면서

bg-15-03.hint: On weekends, I rest or read books.
bg-15-03.why: -거나 attaches directly to any verb stem to show choices.

bg-15-03.q: Write one sentence saying you drink coffee or tea in the morning, using 마시거나.
bg-15-03.why: Attach -거나 directly to the verb stem 마시- to link two action options.

steps.en: I rest at home or read a book.
On Sundays, I rest at home or read a book.

ko: 저는 퇴근 후에 보통 집으로 바로 가요.
피곤한 날에는 따뜻한 물로 샤워하거나 일찍 자요.
en: After work, I usually go straight home.
At home, I cook or watch television.
On tired days, I take a warm shower or go to sleep early.

bg-15-03.q: What does the speaker usually do at home after work?
bg-15-03.why: The passage says '집에서 요리하거나 텔레비전을 봐요' (At home, I cook or watch television).

bg-15-03.q: What does the speaker do on days when they feel tired?
options: Takes a warm shower or sleeps early
Goes out to a loud concert
bg-15-03.why: The passage says '피곤한 날에는 따뜻한 물로 샤워하거나 일찍 자요' (On tired days, I take a warm shower or sleep early).

items: I can link alternative actions or states using -거나
I can distinguish between verb connector -거나 and noun particle -(이)나

bg-15-04.hint: I listen to music while walking.
bg-15-04.why: 걷다 (ㄷ irregular) changes ㄷ to ㄹ before -으면서: 걸으면서.

bg-15-04.q: Write one sentence about what you do if you have free time, using 있으면 and 읽거나.
bg-15-04.sample: 시간이 있으면 책을 읽거나 영화를 봐요.
bg-15-04.why: Use -(으)면 for the condition and -거나 to list alternative activities.

bg-15-04.hint: Verbs ending in ㄹ attach -면서 directly without 으: 만들다 → 만들면서.
bg-15-04.why: ㄹ-stem verbs never insert 으 before -면서: 만들면서.

steps.en: We share a conversation while walking along the trail.
If the weather is nice, we share a conversation while walking along the trail.

ko: 토요일 아침에 날씨가 맑으면 동생과 공원에 가요.
우리는 시원한 바람을 쐬면서 산책로를 걸어요.
오후에는 카페에서 차를 마시거나 도서관에 가요.
en: On Saturday mornings, if the weather is clear, I go to the park with my younger sibling.
We walk along the trail while enjoying the cool breeze.
In the afternoon, we drink tea at a cafe or go to the library.

bg-15-04.q: Under what condition does the speaker go to the park on Saturday morning?
bg-15-04.why: The passage says '날씨가 맑으면 동생과 공원에 가요' (If the weather is clear, I go to the park with my younger sibling).

bg-15-04.q: What do they do in the afternoon?
options: Drink tea at a cafe or go to the library
bg-15-04.why: The passage states '오후에는 카페에서 차를 마시거나 도서관에 가요' (In the afternoon, we drink tea at a cafe or go to the library).

items: I can choose accurately among -(으)면 (condition), -(으)면서 (simultaneous action), and -거나 (choice)
I can conjugate ㄹ-stem and ㄷ-irregular verbs smoothly with all three connectors
